vigil.title: Vigil 24x7
vigil.description: Intelligent management system for private security with automated digitization of operational processes.

caseStudy.challenge: Private security companies manage shift schedules and attendance records using handwritten paper forms, leading to manual data entry errors, delayed reporting, and inefficient resource allocation across multiple sites.
caseStudy.approach: Built an integral platform for human resources optimization and attendance control. The system implements an OCR (Optical Character Recognition) engine to transform handwritten shift forms into processable digital data, eliminating manual entry errors. Includes an automated dashboard for critical metrics visualization and real-time personnel management.

features.title: OCR Engine
features.description: Optical Character Recognition system that transforms handwritten shift schedules into structured digital data, eliminating manual entry errors.

features.title: Personnel Management & Control Dashboard
features.description: Full CRUD for managing security guards, shift assignment, and a real-time dashboard with critical metrics: attendance, coverage, overtime, and payroll settlement.

features.title: Payroll Reports & Export
features.description: Report generation with processed hours data to streamline accounting tasks and personnel salary settlement.

features.title: Client Summaries
features.description: Detailed reports on hours covered at each company or protected location, enabling precise billing control per service.

leyclara.title: Ley Clara
leyclara.description: AI-powered legal platform that translates complex laws into plain language and provides advanced tools for legal professionals.

caseStudy.challenge: Legal regulations are written in complex technical language that most citizens cannot understand. At the same time, legal professionals lack automated tools to analyze, cross-reference, and stay updated on regulatory changes efficiently, resulting in time-consuming manual processes.
caseStudy.approach: Designed and developed an AI-powered legal intelligence platform using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) with LLMs to interpret and analyze legislation. The frontend is built with Angular and PrimeNG, the backend with Node.js and Express, and data is managed through PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Integrates government APIs, OAuth 2.0 + JWT authentication, and is deployed via Docker with Swagger documentation.

features.title: Plain Language Translation
features.description: Translates complex legal regulations into simple, clear language with practical examples and actionable steps for any citizen.

features.title: Contextual AI Search
features.description: Natural language queries powered by RAG that return precise answers based on current legislation and legal databases.

features.title: Legal Document Analysis
features.description: Interprets uploaded PDFs or legal texts and suggests related regulations and case law automatically.

features.title: Personalized Legal Alerts
features.description: Notifies users of relevant regulatory changes based on their profile, industry, or area of interest.

features.title: Regulation Validation
features.description: Indicates whether a law is currently in force, has been modified, or has been repealed.

features.title: Legal Impact Simulation
features.description: Shows how a specific law affects a person, company, or activity through scenario-based analysis.

features.title: Professional Dashboard
features.description: Allows legal professionals to manage consultations, documents, and generate structured legal reports.

vivero.title: Vivero Quilino
vivero.description: Full-stack agricultural e-commerce platform for the digitalization and scalability of regional sales.

caseStudy.challenge: The Quilino Municipal Nursery needed to modernize its sales processes, which were carried out in a traditional and limited way. The challenge was to design a digital solution that would centralize the product catalog, manage orders in real time, and expand the nursery's reach toward a functional and scalable e-commerce model.
caseStudy.approach: Developed the end-to-end user interface alongside a team, prioritizing modular architecture and reactivity. The platform enables fluid catalog navigation, shopping cart management, and clean integration with backend services. A professional design system was implemented using advanced component libraries to guarantee an optimal user experience (UX).

features.title: Reactive Catalog
features.description: Dynamic interface built with Angular that allows filtering and searching agricultural products with high performance.

features.title: E-commerce Management
features.description: Shopping cart system and automated order flow linked with WhatsApp to simplify sales conversion.

features.title: Inventory Management (CRUD)
features.description: Implementation of a complete system for adding, removing, and modifying products and services, ensuring the catalog is kept updated in real time.

lemanja.title: Proyecto Lemanjá
lemanja.description: An immersive and interactive visual experience inspired by the ocean and Lemanjá mythology, combining premium analog sea photography with fluid animations and refined editorial design.

caseStudy.challenge: The challenge was to design a premium landing page that conveys calm, depth, and exclusivity through the sea. Photography had to be the absolute protagonist, requiring optimal loading performance without losing visual quality, and achieving transitions that simulate the movement of waves.
caseStudy.approach: Developed a highly aesthetic interface using Next.js and Framer Motion to achieve fluid animations that mimic the movement of water. I implemented an editorial layout with Playfair Display and Space Mono typography, optimizing heavy images using Next Image and utilizing advanced horizontal scroll techniques and progressive blur effects.

features.title: Immersive Experience
features.description: Use of blurred backdrops (backdrop-filter) and fluid transitions that simulate marine movement when scrolling.

features.title: Premium Editorial Design
features.description: Sophisticated typography and asymmetric layouts inspired by high-end art and photography magazines.

features.title: Interactive Gallery
features.description: Interactive section dividing the view of the sea into three pillars: The Sea, The Current, and The Depth.

features.title: Dynamic Horizontal Scroll
features.description: Fluid horizontal navigation to explore different destinations and photographs from French Polynesia.
